lead.headline: Amundi Tokenizes Index Fund as Prediction Markets Hit $123.6B Monthly Volume
lead.tldr: October 2026 marks a watershed for institutional on-chain adoption: Europe's largest asset manager launches a tokenized fund while prediction markets demonstrate product-market fit at scale, even as mining economics force Core Scientific's pivot and regulatory fault lines deepen in Paraguay.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why the institutional adoption thesis is repricing faster than the infrastructure thesis is collapsing.

top_signals.title: Prediction markets’ biggest month yet, in 3 charts
top_signals.summary: Prediction markets experienced their largest month on record in October 2026, reaching a combined trading volume of $123.6 billion. The growth was driven by record-breaking activity across major venues including Polymarket and Kalshi.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $123.6 billion monthly volume in prediction markets demonstrates that crypto-native financial products can achieve institutional-scale liquidity without institutional intermediaries, which directly challenges how we underwrite value capture in DeFi infrastructure layers.

top_signals.title: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum
top_signals.summary: Amundi, Europe's largest asset manager, has launched a tokenized equity index fund on the Ethereum blockchain. This move expands institutional adoption of on-chain assets as the tokenized stock market grows to $4.24 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Amundi's Ethereum tokenization move validates that the $4.24 billion tokenized stock market is becoming a distribution channel that traditional asset managers cannot ignore, shifting our focus from 'will institutions come' to 'which chain architecture captures their workflow'.

top_signals.title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
top_signals.summary: The President of Paraguay has resigned following the collapse of Ueno digital bank. The resignation comes amid regulatory intervention and intense scrutiny regarding the president's previous business connections to the institution.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Paraguayan president's resignation over a digital bank collapse is a concrete example of how regulatory arbitrage in crypto banking can become systemic political risk, which we now factor into emerging market fintech exposure.

top_signals.title: Core Scientific to quit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI business surges
top_signals.summary: Core Scientific intends to completely exit Bitcoin mining by the end of 2026 to pivot toward AI data center hosting. This shift comes as mining revenue has dwindled to only 7.5% of the company's total business.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Core Scientific's exit with mining at 7.5% of revenue is the cleanest market signal yet that Bitcoin mining economics have been repriced by energy costs and halving pressure, making us underwrite remaining miners on power contract duration rather than hash rate growth.

top_signals.title: Hyperliquid Strategies files to become CFTC-registered FCM, posts $13.3 million in quaterly revenue
top_signals.summary: Hyperliquid Strategies has filed to become a CFTC-registered Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) to legally carry U.S. client accounts for its perpetual futures markets. The firm also reported quarterly revenue of $13.3 million.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Hyperliquid's $13.3 million quarterly revenue alongside its FCM filing shows that perpetual futures venues are generating real cash flows while pursuing regulatory legitimacy, a combination that historically commands premium multiples in financial infrastructure.

deals.company: AAVE (secondary stake acquisition by Payward-affiliated fund)
deals.summary: A fund affiliated with Payward and its clients have acquired a stake in AAVE tokens via the secondary market. This move follows previous reports of a potential discounted stake purchase that were initially pushed back.

Uranium Digital has raised $16.5 million in a Series A funding round led by Blockchain Capital. The startup aims to modernize uranium trading by utilizing blockchain technology to track the ownership of physical uranium.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin erases post-election gains as Wall Street selloff triggers over $1 billion in crypto liquidations
on_the_radar.summary: Bitcoin has erased its post-election gains following a broader Wall Street selloff. This volatility triggered over $1 billion in crypto liquidations, impacting hundreds of thousands of traders.

on_the_radar.title: Base deploys Denim upgrade on mainnet, replacing Flashblocks with 200ms block times
on_the_radar.summary: Base has deployed the Denim upgrade on its mainnet, which replaces Flashblocks with a consistent 200ms block time. This update aims to improve network performance and provide a more stable experience for developers and users.

on_the_radar.title: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks 23m
on_the_radar.summary: The Federal Reserve and the OCC are reviewing US bank security measures following a hack involving Binance. Experts are warning about systemic security risks as traditional financial institutions increase their exposure to digital asset markets.

on_the_radar.title: Samsung Wallet launches USDC accounts on Solana for US Galaxy users
on_the_radar.summary: Samsung Wallet has integrated USDC accounts on the Solana blockchain for eligible users in the United States. This allows Galaxy device users to buy, hold, send, and receive stablecoins directly within the app.

on_the_radar.title: Thailand to block Bitget in December over unlicensed crypto trading
on_the_radar.summary: Thailand's securities regulator will block access to the Bitget cryptocurrency exchange starting December 5. This action follows a criminal complaint filed against the exchange's operator for unlicensed trading activities.

on_the_radar.title: South Korea seeks 4th crypto tax delay, targets 2029 start
on_the_radar.summary: South Korea is seeking to delay the implementation of its 22% cryptocurrency tax for the fourth time, potentially pushing the start date to 2029. The delay is intended to align with the commencement of US crypto tax information exchanges.

on_the_radar.title: Crypto ally French Hill wins reelection but set to lose House chair35m, Crypto ally French Hill wins reelection but set to lose House chairRepublican French Hill secured another term in Congress but will lose his leadership of the House Financial Services Committee when Democrats take control in January., Crypto ally French Hill wins reelection but set to lose House chairRepublican French Hill secured another term in Congress but will lose his leadership of the House Financial Services Committee when Democrats take control in January.
on_the_radar.summary: Republican Representative French Hill has won reelection to Congress but is expected to lose his chairmanship of the House Financial Services Committee. This shift occurs as Democrats are projected to take control of the House in January.

on_the_radar.title: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
on_the_radar.summary: Binance and Deribit have revoked SignalPlus API keys following a security breach caused by a fake Microsoft Teams invite attack. SignalPlus reported that a compromised vendor Telegram account led to an employee's computer being breached, prompting a service suspension and a pledge to reimburse affected users.

linkedin_post:
Prediction markets just printed $123.6 billion in a single month. Not a quarter. A month. Polymarket and Kalshi both hit records in October, and that number is large enough that it no longer reads as an election cycle anomaly.

We're watching the same dynamic in tokenized equities. Amundi, Europe's largest asset manager, put an index fund on Ethereum. The tokenized stock market is $4.24 billion. Small in Amundi's world, not small in ours. The question is whether Ethereum's settlement layer captures the workflow, or whether DTCC and the incumbents build parallel rails that institutions actually use.

Meanwhile Core Scientific is leaving Bitcoin mining entirely. Mining revenue down to 7.5% of the business. The halving worked. We're underwriting the remaining miners on their power contracts, not their hash rate.

The signal that would change our mind: sustained prediction market volume below $40 billion monthly through Q1 2027. That would mean October was borrowed demand. Until then, we price the infrastructure that serves it differently than we did six months ago.

The value is shifting from mining economics to financial product distribution. Again.
